Ui000: Clear audio for calls and streaming · Version 2.1
Ui004: Refresh audio devices after connecting a microphone or installing VB-Cable
Ui009: Select CABLE Output as your microphone in the calling app.
Ui018: Stop processing to change the engine or playback stability.
Ui020: Use headphones to prevent feedback into the microphone.
Ui022: Start denoising to see audio levels and playback stability here.
Ui033: Gentler 25 dB suppression without effects; disables the voice gate to preserve quiet speech.
Ui036: Lower values preserve detail and may leave more noise. DeepFilterNet3 only.
Ui052: Optional; may affect whispers. Stop processing to enable or disable it.
Ui060: Try Softer sound and lower input gain. If the dropout counter increases, stop and choose More stable. Disable additional denoising in your calling app when comparing.
Ui061: Buffer starvation and model artifacts have different causes; these measurements help tell them apart.
Ui062: Choose your microphone and audio destination, then start denoising.
ChooseDevices: Choose a microphone and output first.
NoCable: VB-Cable was not found. Refresh devices after installing it, or choose another output.
Presetnatural: Gentler suppression to preserve speech details; more noise may remain.
Presetstudio: Balanced suppression without EQ or compression.
Presetpodcast: Clearer speech with a low-frequency filter and compression.
Presetmax: Stronger suppression may affect speech details.
BalancedHint: 60 ms buffer: a good starting point for most devices.
StableHint: 100 ms buffer: tolerates scheduling jitter with more latency.
FastHint: 30 ms buffer: less latency, with a higher risk of dropouts.
ActiveStatus: Running with {0}. Select CABLE Output in your calling app.
Format: Input: {0} | Processing: 48 kHz mono | Algorithmic delay: {1:0} ms | Buffer target: {2} ms. Device latency is additional.
Metrics: Slowest frame: {0:0.0} ms / 10 ms | Queued audio: {1:0} ms | Output dropouts: {2}
ClippingDetail: Lower the microphone level in Windows or reduce input gain.
GapDetail: Stop processing and try More stable; close CPU-heavy apps.
Slow: Processing is near its real-time limit
SlowDetail: Each frame lasts 10 ms; try RNNoise if the counter increases.
HealthyDetail: If speech still crackles, try Softer sound; the denoising model may be responsible.
PreservedGate: The voice gate stays disabled; stop denoising before enabling it.
DirectRouting: This output plays audio directly. For calls, select CABLE Input. Use headphones.
WaitingDataDetail: No new measurements have arrived. Check the microphone connection and Windows permissions.
ErrorModelMissing: DeepFilterNet3 model is missing. Reinstall the complete application folder.
ErrorModelIntegrity: The DeepFilterNet3 model file is damaged or does not match the expected version.
ErrorAbi: Update the entire application folder; the DeepFilterNet library version does not match the application.
ErrorOldNative: The DeepFilterNet library is outdated. Extract the new version into a new folder and run it from there.
ErrorMissingNative: The DeepFilterNet library is missing. Reinstall the complete application, or select RNNoise.
ErrorNativeArch: The DeepFilterNet library must be built for Windows x64.
ErrorModelMetadata: The model does not match the required 48 kHz sample rate and 10 ms frames.
ErrorOverload: Processing or the audio device cannot keep up in real time. Try RNNoise or close CPU-heavy applications.
TrayKeepsAudio: Denoising continues in the background. Double-click the icon to restore the window.
TrayHiddenInfo: Double-click the icon to open the app. Right-click to start or stop denoising, or exit.
TrayUnavailable: The notification tray icon is unavailable; normal taskbar minimization is available.
AutomaticHint: Starts with balanced buffering and monitors performance. Recommendations appear in Health; applying them restarts denoising.
Presetcalls: Clear calls with gentle compression and no voice gate.
Presetstreaming: More presence and moderate compression for streaming. Watch the level meter for clipping.
Presetweakmic: Adds 6 dB input gain and gentle compression. If the microphone clips, lower its level in Windows.
Presetwhisper: Gentler denoising without a voice gate to preserve quiet speech and whispers.
AdviceEnableAuto: Select Automatic buffering to monitor your device and receive recommendations.
AdviceObserving: Monitoring processing time and gaps for 5 seconds…
AdviceHealthy: Performance has been stable in the recent observation window.
AdviceMoreBuffer: Gaps or near-budget processing detected. Try Stable mode for a larger buffer.
AdviceLightweight: DeepFilterNet3 repeatedly exceeded the processing budget. Try lighter RNNoise with the voice gate disabled.
AdviceCheckDevice: The device or processing is unstable. Check connections and close demanding apps.
RecordHint: Record 10 seconds using the current microphone and settings. Original and processed audio are delay-aligned and loudness-matched by reducing the louder version. Audio stays in local memory until you close the app; use headphones.
RecordReady: Recording ready. Listen to both versions at matched loudness.
RecordDisableBypass: Turn off processing bypass before recording a comparison.
PreviewWarning: Listening stops live denoising to avoid microphone feedback. Press Start denoising when finished. The test playback device does not change your call output.
StartupOption: Start with Windows — minimized to the tray
StartupHint: Optional for the current user. Starts denoising with saved devices and settings only when both devices are available; missing devices trigger a notice. Mic test recording never starts automatically.
StartupInstallFirst: Install the app or run MicDenoiser.exe to enable Windows startup.
StartupMissingDevices: Saved devices are unavailable. Open the app and select microphone and output before starting denoising.
DeviceDisconnected: An audio device disconnected. Denoising stopped; reconnect it or choose another device, then start again.
DeviceAudioStopped: Denoising stopped because of an audio problem. Review the error details and reselect devices if needed.
DeviceChooseAgain: Choose microphone and output, then start denoising.
DeviceWatchUnavailable: Device connection monitoring is unavailable. Refresh devices after changing your microphone.
